title: DPOMetadata
description: Sediment evidence for one DPO pair.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

source_model.description: The model that served the source inference call.

rejected_completion_id.description: The dispreferred inference call from the same prompt and model.

recipe_id.description: The closed evidence recipe that produced this training row.

recipe_version.description: The version of the evidence recipe; increment it when recipe semantics change.

chosen_label_source.description: The closed evidence source that labeled the preferred member.

rejected_label_source.description: The closed evidence source that labeled the dispreferred member.

label_confidence.description: The weaker member confidence — how much to trust the pair.

ci_reliability.description: Trust in the resolved CI evidence, separate from the categorical label.

confidence_margin.description: Chosen confidence minus rejected. Can be negative when attribution discounts or configured confidence factors outweigh direction.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

split.description: Which side of the deterministic eval split this row is on, hashed on `session_id` so a session never straddles both.

chosen_repository_identity.description: Qualified repository identity of the chosen member; null for an unambiguous legacy repository.

rejected_repository_identity.description: Qualified repository identity of the rejected member; independent of the chosen member.

chosen_attribution_source.description: The selected preferred member's inferred Attribution method, or null without Attribution.

rejected_attribution_source.description: The selected dispreferred member's inferred Attribution method, or null without Attribution.

chosen_session_commit_observation_ids.description: Sorted unique observation IDs for the preferred member's exact Session-to-commit edge; empty when absent.

rejected_session_commit_observation_ids.description: Sorted unique observation IDs for the dispreferred member's exact Session-to-commit edge; empty when absent.

schema_id.description: The canonical wire-shape contract for this row.

schema_version.description: The positive integer version of the canonical row schema.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.

provider.description: The forge provider that assigns the immutable repository ID.

repository_id.description: Immutable provider repository ID within its forge host.
